From the Brighton Beach streets of “ Little Odessa ,” his 1994 debut, to “ The Yards ,” “ We Own The Night ,” “ Two Lovers ,” “ The Immigrant ,” and “ Armageddon Time ,” the city has remained a constant presence in his work.
